calm, steady news narration with natural emphasis at key points and turns; not dramatic.
Speak at a slightly slower, relaxed pace than natural adult narration, while keeping the delivery smooth, conversational, and natural. Do not exaggerate pauses or sound instructional.
asr_text: As a parent of a middle school child, I want to choose how much they use social media, based on what they can handle. Rather than draw a line based only on age, I think it would be better, if possible, to let them use more features step-by-step, as they learn to handle them. I don't want the only choices to be letting them use it or banning it. I want different steps. If my child started using social media with no preparation as soon as they reached the age when it had been banned, I would worry. I don't think reaching the age when it's okay to use it means they'll suddenly know how to keep themselves safe. Just as you need to practice swimming before going into the sea, it's still scary when a child who isn't ready is suddenly thrown into it.
